Name: Boaz
Summary: Boaz was a wealthy and godly landowner of Bethlehem who acted as kinsman-redeemer for Ruth and Naomi. He is a beautiful picture of Christ, our Redeemer.
KeyStory: Boaz protected Ruth in his fields, spoke kindly to her, and redeemed her at the city gate, taking her as his wife.
LifeLesson: Boaz shows us a Redeemer who notices, protects, and pays the full price. That is exactly what Jesus has done for you — you are redeemed, wanted, and covered.
